title: [Regression] `Module not found` to `url()` function (sass) when compiling

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### What version of Next.js are you using?

12.0.3

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.17.0

### What browser are you using?

Chrome

### What operating system are you using?

Windows

### How are you deploying your application?

Vercel

### Describe the Bug

From `next` [v12.0.3-canary.2](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/releases/tag/v12.0.3-canary.2), [special functions](https://sass-lang.com/documentation/syntax/special-functions) of `sass` , like _url_, aren't compiled correctly.

### Actual Behavior
```console
ready - started server on 0.0.0.0:3000, url: http://localhost:3000
error - ./pages/style.scss:4:0
Module not found: Can't resolve './data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64'

Import trace for requested module:
./pages/style.scss
./pages/_app.js

https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/module-not-found
wait  - compiling...
error - ./pages/style.scss:4:0
Module not found: Can't resolve './data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64'

Import trace for requested module:
./pages/style.scss
./pages/_app.js

https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/module-not-found
```

### Expected Behavior

Compiling done.

### To Reproduce

1. `yarn init -y`
2. `yarn set version berry`
3. `yarn add next@canary react react-dom sass`
4. Create `pages/_app.js` file:
```js
import './style.scss'
```
5. Create `pages/style.scss` file:
```scss
@font-face {
  src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64) format('woff');
}
```
6. `yarn next`

OR (my use case)

1. Clone [material-ui + next](https://github.com/mui-org/material-ui/tree/master/examples/nextjs) example
2. `yarn set version berry`
3. `yarn add @mui/material@5.0.4 next@canary sass videojs-font`
4. Create `pages/style.scss` file:
```scss
@import 'videojs-font/scss/icons';
```
5. Add in `pages/_app.js` file on first line:
```js
import './style.scss'
```
6. `yarn next`
